headline: 6 more witnesses testify against former IGP Benazir Ahmed in wealth case
summary: A Dhaka court has heard testimony from six additional witnesses in a corruption case involving the former police chief, who is currently detained in Dubai.
details: A Dhaka court has recorded the testimony of six more witnesses in a case filed by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) against former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Benazir Ahmed.
The witnesses, including sub-registrars from various districts and a deputy director of the Forest Department, testified before Judge Abdullah Al Mamun of the Special Judge Court-5 on Wednesday.

Benazir Ahmed was arrested by Dubai police on June 12 following an Interpol Red Notice. The Bangladesh government is currently working to extradite him back to the country.
caption:
14 of 28 witnesses have now testified against former IGP Benazir Ahmed in a case involving BDT 11 crore in illegal wealth.

A Dhaka court has recorded the testimony of six more witnesses in a case filed by the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) against former Inspector General of Police (IGP) Benazir Ahmed.

The witnesses, including sub-registrars from various districts and a deputy director of the Forest Department, testified before Judge Abdullah Al Mamun of the Special Judge Court-5 on Wednesday.

Out of a total of 28 witnesses in the case, 14 have now provided their testimony. The court has scheduled the next hearing for July 16.

The ACC alleges that Benazir Ahmed acquired assets worth BDT 11.04 crore beyond his known sources of income.

The charge sheet alleges that the illegally acquired funds were hidden and invested in various bank accounts, business enterprises, and joint venture companies.

Benazir Ahmed was arrested by Dubai police on June 12 following an Interpol Red Notice. The Bangladesh government is currently working to extradite him back to the country.

headline_marked: BNP leader [[Nazrul Islam Khan admitted to hospital]] in Dhaka
headline: BNP leader Nazrul Islam Khan admitted to hospital in Dhaka
summary: The Standing Committee member and advisor to the party chairperson was admitted to Evercare Hospital on June 30.
details: Nazrul Islam Khan, a member of the BNP Standing Committee and advisor to the party chairperson, has been admitted to Evercare Hospital in Dhaka.
The news was confirmed on Wednesday by Shairul Kabir Khan, a member of the BNP media cell.
Nazrul Islam Khan had returned to Bangladesh from Singapore on June 25.
He was admitted to the hospital on June 30 and is currently receiving treatment under the guidance of doctors.
Following medical advice, visitors have been requested not to meet with him for the time being.
